question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Rebellious
solution:
The correct answer is **"Unruly"** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** Here we will learn about the given synonyms:

__
 
• **Rebellious - **If a group of people are rebellious, they oppose the ideas of the people in authority and plan to change the system, often using force

 
 
• ***​Eg.*** Her teachers regard her as a* rebellious*, trouble-making girl.
 
 
 
• **​Unruly - **Unruly people are difficult to control and often do not obey rules
 
 
• ***​Eg. ***An *unruly* class of adolescents​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's see some other words and their meanings:

 
• **Manageable **- easy or possible to deal with:

 
 
• ***​Eg***. The work has been divided into smaller, more *manageable* sections.​ 
 
 
 
• ​**Happy - **feeling, showing, or causing pleasure or satisfaction 
 
 
• ***​Eg.*** She looks so *happy*
 
 
 
• **​Obedient -** doing, or willing to do, what you have been told to do by someone in authority:
 
 
• ***​Eg.*** Students are expected to be quiet and *obedient *in the classroom.
